findings.fix: Move `[Fintype ι]` off the Pi section and prove the structural equivalence for arbitrary `ι`, deriving the finite rank/cardinality theorems as special cases.
findings.issue: `elementaryTwoQuotientPiLinearEquiv` is stated under `[Fintype ι]`, although quotienting a full product by coordinatewise squares commutes with arbitrary products; only `twoRank_pi` and `card_elementaryTwoQuotient_pi` need finite `ι`.

summary: The finite rank and cardinality corollaries are at the right level, but the structural indexed-product equivalence is unnecessarily restricted to finite index types.
